sources.title: SaMD lifecycle standards (IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, ISO 13485)
sources.why: IEC 62304 and ISO 14971 govern software lifecycle and risk control, directly mandating fault detection, error handling, and reliable operation.

sources.title: ISO/IEC 82304-2 — health software quality & safety
sources.why: This quality and safety standard for non-device health apps covers software reliability and stability dimensions used for conformity self-scoring.

sources.title: PLD — Product Liability Directive (software & AI)
sources.why: Treats software crashes and malfunctions as defects causing harm, requiring documented risk management and defect-avoidance to limit liability.
